items.title: Vince DiMartino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 8, 2025
items.q: And I’d find — oh look there’s a new Harry James record. I’ve got to have this.

ctx.x: And I’d find — oh look there’s a new Harry James record. I’ve got to have this. You know and then the record collection kept — and when I gave away my records, except for the ones that are sort of collectors’ things for me I had over 800 of those. I have way over a thousand CDs. And now, with all the digital stuff, I don’t even know what I have. I have 15,000 pieces of music that are catalogued.
Okay take me back to “Perdido” because I’m curious as after you played the melody did the band leader say, “Okay you got it.”
